notes.title: Patch: Version 1.0.1 release
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Bubble Bobble 4 Friends: The Baron's Workshop!
 
We've just released a patch to fix the following issues listed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1287030/discussions/0/2957167122116765115/]here[/url], specifically
[olist]
[*]The original Bubble Bobble running too fast
In order to be as close as possible to the original arcade game's performance on modern hardware, we locked the frame rate of teh game. Please be aware that tearing may occur depending on the refresh rate of your monitor.
[*]Analog stick moving of its own accord[/olist]

If the patch works for you, please let us know and thank you all again for your patience! .

To report new or unaddressed issues, please see this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1287030/discussions/0/2957167122116765115
 
Thanks, the Taito Steam team

notes.title: Out Now! 15% off and a level design contest?!
notes.content:
It's that day every bubble dragon fan has been waiting for! Launch day for Bubble Bobble 4 Friends: The Baron's Workshop and we have a 15% off sale and level design contest to help celebrate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110557/35a1361a56db501560e9f9f6b6b0f340c5f244ca.png[/img]

[h1]Workshop Mode[/h1]
First, we launched on Switch, then [b]added 100 new, tougher stages[/b] and the invincible Baron von Blubba as a free update for the PS4 release. Now Steam players get all that content, plus an [b][i]exclusive Workshop Mode[/i][/b] so all you budding-bubble dragons can build better stages with blocks, bullies and more!
Not sure what to build? Need some inspiration? Well, Bub's here to try out some of the designs the Taito development team put together in his first Let's Play video!

[previewyoutube=KwJeFoUWHIU;full][/previewyoutube]
And if you think you can better Bub’s skills, we’ve uploaded the dev team’s to Steam’s Workshop for you to try!

[h1]Level Design Contest![/h1]
To enter, just design a level, upload it to Steam’s Workshop and tag it with [b][i]#BB4Fcontest[/i][/b]; simple! For details, check the contest post here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1287030/view/2863717429845507169
Winners will be played by Bub in an upcoming Let’s Play video on his channel!
https://www.youtube.com/c/BubblunChannel

[h1]Launch Sale![/h1]
Starting today there’s 15% off for one week in our special launch sale! Don’t miss out!

[h1]The dev team’s stage![/h1]
I uploaded the stages created by the dev team to Steam's Workshop so here are the links and a quick guide on how to play them:

1) Click on the link for the stage you want to play
2) Click the Subscribe button
3) Load the game, go to the Workshop Mode's settings, to Download then switch the tab to Subscribe
4) Download the stage data

[b]The stage link[/b]
-Lever Designer stages
Action: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2615007877
Wind: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2615008756
Battle: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2615009392 
- Artist stage
Birthday cake: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2614991217
- Marketing person's stage
Fujiyama: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2615022794

notes.title: Coming Summer 2021: Bubble Bobble 4 Friends: The Baron's Workshop
notes.content:
After a successful launch on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation®4, Bubble Bobble 4 Friends is ready to burst onto Steam! 

[h2]A Whole New Mode?![/h2]
To make up for the wait, the Steam version's getting a new, exclusive mode that will let Bubble Bobble fans everywhere [i]create and share their own stages[/i] in Workshop Mode!
To reflect the devious stages we know you'll come up with, we've changed the name to [b]Bubble Bobble 4 Friends: The Baron's Workshop[/b], in honour of everyone's favourite series villain, Baron von Blubba. We have a new trailer too, to give you an idea of what to expect from the new mode.

[previewyoutube=IlJDZHXW3ek;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Workshop Mode[/h2]
In this new mode, you'll be able to create your own, unique stages by placing blocks, enemies and the bubble-carrying wind exactly where you want them. New blocks and enemies can be unlocked by playing through the game's story. And thanks to Steam's Workshop, you can share them with players everywhere and try out their stages too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110557/55954881850de47e58a279d9b028f1d86d21eca1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110557/7870a808aa8d3c197a3fd090d5c232d06bd0bb42.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110557/10a28797a12ad623b0e094aef3482adb21a72585.jpg[/img]

[h2]But When?![/h2]
The release date is just around the corner...
